## Summary

Describe the compiler, runtime, documentation, or benchmark change.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused CPU tests pass.
- [ ] GPU changes include A100 parity evidence, or explain why GPU validation was not run.
- [ ] Performance claims include raw results, correctness gates, and regressions.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or ephemeral infrastructure identifiers are included.
- [ ] Documentation and supported-subset statements are updated when behavior changes.
